response.name: a(0)=0; a(n) is the smallest m such that m - a(i) is not a triangular number for any i < n.
program: from itertools import count, islice, takewhile
triangulars = takewhile(lambda x: x <= i, (n*(n+1)//2 for n in count(1)))
if all(i - t not in seq for t in triangulars):
